EXCELLENT CONDITION! Multiple available, heavy duty commercial grade machine with a 20amp plug and touch screen console! Incline from -3% to 15%, speeds up to 16mph, and a 4 HP high-efficiency AC-motor.

Precor TRM 865 Treadmill With P62 Console
When you combine a runner’s passion with engineering ingenuity, the result is the Precor TRM 800 Line treadmill. Intended for elite milers and marathoners, the Precor TRM 800 can reach speeds up to 16 MPH, offers uphill and downhill training options, is powered by a 4-horsepower energy-efficient motor, and features pre-programmed workouts for the most comprehensive training regimen you can find.
This treadmill requires a dedicated 120V/20A circuit with a 5-20R NEMA receptacle to operate in a home.
UNPARALLELED PERFORMANCE - Found in high-end gyms and five-star resorts everywhere, the US-built Precor TRM 800 will be your training partner for years, all the while minimizing the wear and tear on your body.
INTEGRATED FOOTPLANT TECHNOLOGY - LIKE RUNNING OUTSIDE
Most treadmill belts run at a steady speed making them feel too treadmill-y. Our patented technology controls the belt’s rate of deceleration when you plant your foot and the rate of acceleration when you push off making it feel as though you’re running on a natural surface.
GLIDE DOWNHILL - PUSH YOURSELF UPHILL
As one of the only treadmills on the market to offer a 15% incline and 3% decline elevation range, you can train for both the uphill and downhill portions of a marathon. With speeds of up to 16 MPH and a 60” running surface you have plenty of room to run as fast as you want.
MOTOR DRIVE SYSTEM - POWERFUL & EFFICIENT
The high-efficiency AC-motor drive, capable of 4HP operation with 8 HP peak is optimized with Power Factor Correction for increased efficiency, improved performance, and reduced energy consumption by up to 30%.
P62 Console - Same media goodness as the P82 with a more compact 10” built-in touch screen. The feel-good design makes it easy to adjust your workout or entertainment on-the-fly.

items.title: 1966 Massey Ferguson 165 Diesel Multi-Power — Overhauled 104 Hours Ago
items.ai_notes: [1966 Massey Ferguson 165 diesel tractor] Well-maintained vintage tractor; price reflects recent mechanical work.
items.description:
1966 Massey Ferguson 165 diesel with Multi-Power. Detroit-built. Perkins AD4.203 3.3L 4-cylinder diesel — original engine and it is sound. We left the motor alone because it didn’t need it, other than a new thermostat and the small hose that is hard to reach. Both were replaced. We also added drip-fuel glow plug starting so it starts easier in cold weather.
This tractor was split and gone through by an experienced Massey Ferguson mechanic (my dad) and me. Work completed 104 hours ago:
New clutch
Gearbox refurbished
Final drives gone through
Brakes refurbished
Hydraulic pump rebuilt
Control lever / draft-control linkage completely readjusted to factory settings — this system now works correctly and is a big reason this tractor operates so well
New thermostat and hard-to-reach hose
Drip-fuel glow plug starting added
New rear rims — the originals were rusted out from calcium chloride like most of these from that era. Tires are air only now (no chloride). Rear wheels are sliding adjustable rims with hub weights.
The Perkins starts easily, runs strong, and has good oil pressure. Multi-Power works as it should. Hydraulics are strong after the pump rebuild. 3-point and PTO function properly.
Straight tinwork, clean example. Wide front axle. Open station.
This is not a “it runs” tractor. It was taken apart, put back together correctly, and the complicated control system was set the way Massey intended. Ready to work or keep as a nice collector.
Serious inquiries only. Can send more photos or videos of it running.

items.title: 1999 Ducati 996S for sale
items.ai_notes: [1999 Ducati 996S] High-end collectible motorcycle; very niche market.
items.description:
1999 Ducati 996S,  No 015, From Ducati MS forum; "An authentic plaque reading "Ducati 996S  015" confirms that the bike is an early, highly sought-after 1999 Ducati 996 S. Standard 996 S as completely unnumbered applied mostly to the subsequent 2000–2001 mass-production versions. The 1999 model year was a unique exception in Ducati history. When Ducati first introduced the "S" trim to specific markets (primarily the United States) in 1999, it wasn't just a mid-tier catalog option,  it was treated as a semi-exclusive introductory variant. To mark this introductory launch, Ducati outfitted the 1999 models with a sequentially numbered, riveted metal badge directly on the top triple clamp. Because this plaque shows 015, this bike was one of the earliest off the Borgo Panigale production line for that specific introductory configuration.   "Open-Ended" Series: Unlike true limited editions (which usually display an "X / 500" format), these early 1999 996 S plaques only displayed the sequence number itself. Ducati kept the total production open-ended to gauge market demand before expanding the line into normal mass production for the 2000 and 2001 model years when the plaques were dropped."
Second owner, bought in 2008. 17,000 miles, but replaced speedo shows 12,900. All body work and tank have been repainted and clear coated, 1000 and 2000 wet sanded. S model includes Marchesini wheels, Olin rear shock and steering stabilizer, up graded Showa front forks. Less then 20 miles on new Pirelli diablo tires, front 120/70, rear 180/55, new battery, new timing belts and oil change, starter motor. red suede mono seat, also have dual seat and subframe with passenger footpegs.Gold anodized sprocket and chain covers, Pazzo front brake and clutch levers. items.title: 200 amp Load center / Circuit breaker box: 3 PHASE
items.ai_notes: [Cutler-Hammer 200 amp 3-phase load center] Specialized electrical equipment; high value but niche market.
items.description:
This is a salvaged Cutler-Hammer from a building demolition, and is believed to be in good working condition. It is a 3BR4242B200 cabinet and load bar, with cover plate.
The original 44 lug ground bar has been replaced with two 24-lug grounding bus bars on either side of the breakers.
Included breakers: Three 50 amp, two 40-amp. one 30-amp, one 20-amp, one 15-amp, and one duplex 20-amp,
All the knockouts have been removed from the cover plate, but UL-listed covers for the open spaces are readily available at most hardware centers.
3BR4242B200 Breakdown (Catalog Number)
This number defines the overall specifications for the panelboard as a complete unit.
3: Indicates 3-Phase power.
BR: Specifies the Breaker Type. This panel uses 1-inch "BR" style plug-on breakers.
42: The number of Spaces. This panel has 42 physical slots for breakers.
42: The number of Circuits. This means the panel is not designed for "twin" breakers; it supports 42 total circuits.
B: Indicates it is a Main Breaker unit (factory installed) rather than "Main Lug Only" (MLO).
200: The Amperage Rating. This unit is rated for 200 Amps.
I am selling this device for $450, available for pickup at our office in South Kansas City, Missouri.
Shipping is available to anywhere in the United States for an additional 25 dollars.
Call me to arrange any pickup or to ask questions.

items.title: MINT 1985 Kansas City Royals 5-Piece World Series Print Archive
items.ai_notes: [1985 KC Royals World Series print archive] High-end sports memorabilia; value is driven by condition and rarity.
items.description:
Offered from a private local collection: a complete, museum-grade 5-piece print archive from the 1985 Kansas City Royals World Series championship.
This is not a collection of yellowed, folded attic papers. Every piece in this set has been preserved in clean, unread, flawless condition for over 40 years. It tells the complete story of the 1985 title—from the pre-series preview to the Game 7 victory celebrations.
What Is Included in This 5-Piece Collection:
Sports Illustrated (Nov. 4, 1985) - "A Royal Crown" (2 COPIES): Two separate, pristine copies of the famous championship issue. Both are rare NEWSSTAND EDITIONS with no subscriber mailing labels printed on the covers. Perfect for having one copy on display while keeping the second stored or submitted for grading.
Sports Illustrated (Oct. 28, 1985) - "The World Series / Ozzie Smith": The official World Series Preview issue printed right before Game 1. Also an unprinted newsstand copy with razor-sharp edges and bright cover inks.
The Kansas City Star (Oct. 28, 1985) - "World Champions!": The iconic morning-after newspaper wrap. Features clean white pages, zero sun fading, and no dark fold creases across the headline. Includes all original 1985 local ads inside.
The Squire’s Other Paper (Oct. 31, 1985) - "Free At Last!": An ultra-rare local Kansas City suburban newspaper printed right after Game 7. Because this publisher went out of print years ago, surviving copies in this unread condition are almost impossible to find anywhere on the market today.
Why This Set Is Unique:
Buying these items individually in this condition requires months of searching and multiple shipping fees. This listing offers a complete, pre-curated 1985 time capsule ready for custom framing, a home sports room, or an executive office display. Would make a unique gift for a Royal's fan.
Condition Notes:
Please inspect the close-up photos. The paper is bright, the spine edges are sharp, and the pages are unread. You are buying high-grade, investment-quality paper.

I have included Honda's description of the Honda Pioneer 1000 3 Limited Edition features:
ENGINEERING
- ADVANCED TRANSMISSION LOGIC
i-4WD System: Industry-first brake-traction control that acts like a locked front differential but with lighter steering, better tracking, and a tighter turning radius. The brain of the DCT, Advanced Transmission Logic, senses how you drive and adapts. Relaxed drivers get earlier shifts for a quieter ride at lower engine speeds. Sportier drivers will hold each gear longer for higher RPM shifts. And when going downhill, you get true engine braking. Now that’s a smart transmission.
Fully Automatic Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) with six forward gears and Reverse. Four drive modes include 2WD, 4WD, Turf and Differential lock. Paddle Shifters with three shift modes (standard, sport, and manual)
- Driveline
Direct front and rear driveshafts
PERFORMANCE
- POWERFUL 999cc TWIN-CYLINDER ENGINE
When you know the power you need is always at the ready, every drive is an enjoyable experience. And that’s precisely what you get out of the class-leading 999cc liquid-cooled inline twin. Using the same Unicam® cylinder head design found in our motocross bikes, it’s more compact in size, and it still delivers the kind of horsepower and torque you’d expect from a flagship model.
- 2000-POUND TOWING CAPACITY
Call it 2000 pounds, or call it 1 ton. Either way, the towing capacity of the Pioneer 1000-3 is unsurpassed by any competitor. So instead of hopping on the tractor or taking out the truck, you can stay right in your side-by-side and tackle those bigger jobs with relative ease.
HANDLING
- CHASSIS SUSPENSION BRAKES
Prepare to go further than ever before. Our refined chassis enables you to tackle terrain others would shy away from, with larger tires, long-travel independent front and rear suspension and huge ground clearance. The rubber mounted engine and exhaust system insulates against excessive vibration and the self-leveling rear suspension compensation for changing loads.
- Front Suspension
Independent double-wishbone with FOX quick-adjust shocks with 10.6" of travel
- Rear Suspension
Independent double-wishbone with FOX quick-adjust shocks with 10" of travel
- Front Brake
Dual 210mm hydraulic discs
- Rear Brake
Dual 210mm hydraulic discs
- BIGGER TIRES
Practically speaking, the Maxxis Bighorn tires with radial construction, 6 ply construction and premium style.27-inch tires on 14-inch rims help increase ground clearance, improve ride comfort, and deliver better traction.
- Front Tires 27 x 9-14
- Rear Tires 27 x 11-14
- ELECTRIC POWER STEERING
Honda Electric Power Steering system helps eliminate bump steer through rocky and rutted terrain, which reduces fatigue. What makes it even better is the added assist you get when you need it most, like when you’re in 4WD, driving at lower speeds, or maneuvering over rough conditions.
- PADDLE SHIFTING
Steering column-mounted paddle shifters add a serious dose of performance in every drive. In Manual mode, they let you shift without ever taking your hands off the wheel, and in Automatic mode, they let you override the current gear with a quick up or downshift, holding that gear for several seconds before returning to Automatic mode.
- TURF/2WD/4WD/DIFF LOCK
Don’t tear up sensitive surfaces. Select Turf Mode. Want to access as much traction as possible? Put it in 4WD. Need maximum power at all four wheels? Lock the front and rear differentials. And the best part is, you can do it all with a shift of a single lever.
VERSATILITY
- 1000-POUND-CAPACITY TILT BED
There are a ton of reasons to buy a Pioneer 1000-3. Among them: the half-ton hauling capacity*. No side-by-side can haul more, and when it comes to dumping, we’ve made it easier than ever, with a hydraulic assist tilt bed lever that can be accessed from outside the vehicle, or right from the driver’s seat.
COMFORT
- 3-PERSON CONTOURED BENCH SEAT
Tough, durable and built to enhance every driving experience — yes, we’re talking about the seat. Contoured for three passengers, the center seat is positioned up and forward to maximize space and comfort, and the covering is designed to resist both the elements and heavy use.
- LCD DISPLAY
The multi-function LCD dash display is large enough to host loads of information, in an easy-to-read way, like speed and fuel level. RPM and transmission mode. Fuel gauge, water temperature, trip information and more. It even includes a clock, so you’ll always know when it’s time for some fun.
- SOPHISTICATED CHASSIS
Some of the most impressive Pioneer 1000-3 features are those you’ll never see. In addition to the suspension and ground clearance, we rubber-mounted the engine and exhaust system to insulate the cabin against excessive vibration. So while you may not see this feature, it’s one you will definitely notice.
- TILT WHEEL
With a tilt steering wheel, you’re ensured an even more comfortable driving experience. We’ve given the wheel a wide range of adjustments for optimum customization, and it even moves very far forward to allow for easy entry and exit.
SAFETY
- DRIVER/PASSENGER PROTECTION
The Occupant Protection Structure uses large-diameter tubing, and meets OSHA’s rollover protection standard. The hard doors and roll-up side nets help keep debris from entering the cabin, and auto-style three-point seatbelts are equipped with an emergency locking retractor mechanism, to help optimize passenger security. When you put this much safety first, fun is sure to follow.
- FOUR-WHEEL DISC BRAKES
The Pioneer’s uncompromising power helps take you further than ever before. The reliable disc brakes help you stop on a dime. Built to the same standard as you’d find in our autos, the four-wheel disc brakes minimize debris from building up, ensuring consistent performance, and giving you confidence on the trail.

items.title: Vintage Koch Commercial Butcher Block Countertop Section
items.ai_notes: [Vintage Koch butcher block countertop] Unique historical piece; niche appeal for kitchen renovations.
items.description:
A very rare find and piece of Kansas City history.  A near new section of unused hard maple commercial butcher block counter top that is at least 63 years old.  Measures 42 1/2” long, 18” wide and 2” thick. The maple strips are both glued and bolted together, making it suitable for daily use in a commercial environment.  The maple in this counter are full length boards rather than the smaller finger-jointed sections of wood seen in modern hard maple butcher blocks.  Would make a great conversation piece inside your home or used in the prep area of an outdoor kitchen. The “K.C 8 MO” stamp branded in the edge indicates it was made before 1963 when the modern 5-digit ZIP code system introduced.  Koch was a major manufacturer of butcher shop equipment, and based here in the Kansas City area.
No shipping on this item. The buyer will need to pick up in the east Independence area.

items.title: PullRite SuperLite 20K Single Point Attachment Gooseneck and 5th Wheel
items.ai_notes: [PullRite SuperLite 20K Fifth Wheel Hitch] Missing pull handle, which is a simple fix; otherwise new.
items.description:
PullRite SuperLite 20K Single Point Attachment Gooseneck and Fifth Wheel.  This is Brand New.  Ready for gooseneck.  If wanting to tow 5th wheel, I do not have the 5th wheel King Pin adapter but can be purchased online for $150-$175. The pull handle is missing but may find it.  If not, it can be purchased or make one out of a rod by bending a hook on end.  There is clear shipping protectant over label that can be removed and why the label looks cracked. This with the King Pin adapter sells for $850 to $1000.
Can be installed as 1 point over existing gooseneck ball or if you have rails, can be installed as a 4 point mount.
NOTE:  GMC/Chevy trucks require both #2616 Bed Support Bracket and #2620 GMC/Chevy Puck Plug Set (both purchased separately).  Not required for Ford and Dodge.
From PullRite:
Attachment, lightweight, fifth wheel hitch is designed for any OE or aftermarket undermount gooseneck towing system and is unlike any other hitch of its kind on the market today.  Strong, American steel vs. those weaker aluminum models and still only 64 lbs. lifting weight, the SuperLite 1P hitch gives you confidence that you're towing with the best!
The #2600 SuperLite fifth wheel hitch is designed to tow gooseneck trailers and typically mounts to a single point, standard 2-5/16" ball.  These types of mounting systems are available as an aftermarket product or come OE equipped (factory direct).
We converted the fifth wheel trailer's king pin to a ball and turned the hitch plate into a funnel, making it the easiest hitch on the market to hook up.  Totally visible from the cab, you simply drop the trailer's converted ball anywhere on the diameter of the funnel and lower your trailer!  The Remote Latch system locks/unlocks the ball into funnel and keeps you out of the bed–and there are no secondary locking devices to engage.

items.title: 2024 Legend 8X23FTVTA52 Enclosed ATV Trailer 23 Ft Long
items.ai_notes: [2024 Legend 8x23 enclosed trailer] High-value item; resale percentage is high for late-model trailers in good condition.
items.description:
This 2024 Legend enclosed ATV/UTV trailer measures 23 feet long by 8 feet wide with a 90-inch interior height plus an extra 12 inches. It has a flat top V-nose design and comes in royal blue. The trailer features two 5200 lb Dexter EZ-Lube axles with brakes on both, spread axle setup, and a GVWR of 9990 lb. It weighs about 2707 lb empty. Tires are ST225/75R15 on black aluminum rims, and a spare tire is included with mount.
The frame uses 2"x6" tubing with 2"x3" crossmembers spaced 16 inches apart. Walls and roof consist of engineered wood and tube framing, with a one-piece roof backed by a 25-year warranty. The rear door is a wide 85"x85" ramp, plus there's a gull-wing door on the roadside and a 30"x68" side door on the curbside. Electrical includes 110V and multiple LED lights inside and out. Some extras are 1000 lb loose D-rings, skid pads, stone guard, and a heavy-duty tongue jack.
The trailer carries limited lifetime structural and 5-year axle warranties, plus a tire and rim warranty package. It’s designed as a bumper pull with a 2-5/16" coupler and includes stabilizer jacks. Overall, it’s a sturdy trailer built with aluminum rims and a solid frame, suited for hauling ATVs and UTVs enclosed.

She currently has a blind quarter. Her first lactation, all four quarters were great. After calving for a second time, one of her front teats would not fill up properly and stopped producing, but she is good in the remaining 3.

items.title: Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Guitar Amplifier and Foot Pedals
items.ai_notes: [Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Guitar Amp] Vintage digital modeling amp; niche appeal but includes all original accessories.
items.description:
Used Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Digital Modeling Guitar Combo Amp in Excellent Condition. Comes with  factory amp cover, carry case for J-12 foot controller and J-3 foot switch, both pedals are included along with the users manual. Looks new! I have owned this for about 24 years now and didn’t use it very much. There are several factory settings that sound great and you can dial in your own settings.
From the Johnson website: "The Johnson Millennium is the world's first Tube Integrated Modeling Amplifier. The Millennium can easily emulate the most sought-after vintage and modern guitar amps in the world. If you are in need of effects processing, the JM150's full function signal processing section lets you add up to 4 studio quality effects with total control over all parameters. Powered by 150 watts through 2 Celestion Vintage 30 loudspeakers.
Dual preamp design
Two 12AX7 tubes
150 watt stereo power amp section
True amplifier and effects morphing
Up to 4 studio quality effects at once
Full MIDI implementation
Chromatic tuner
S-DISC II processing power
Line Level speaker compensated XLR outputs
J-3 Multi-function footswitch included
J-12 Foot Controller included
Analog, digital, and tube circuitry, combined to give you the convenience of modern technology coupled with the tones of vintage circuitry. Johnson Amplification has real tubes. Another reason for the accurate modeling is that they examine the frequency responses, and the EQ curves of classic amps. All of that data is then stored in the appropriate models for instant recall.
Easy access to the sounds of your favorite tones is what Tube Integrated Modeling Amplification is all about. There is no easier way to access those tones than with a Johnson amp. If you want the sound of a British Stack... push a button. If you want the sound of a vintage American combo...push a button. It's just that easy. Johnson Amplification also provides effects processing that those historic amps didn't include. Adding effects is as easy as pressing a button. Johnson amps also include dozens of user and factory presets. Recalling any preset is as easy as using a footswitch, or turning a knob.

items.description:
Vintage 1968 Bally World Cup electromechanical soccer arcade game.
Working and playable. Lights, gameplay and scoring operate. The game is currently started manually. The original quarter/coin mechanism is present but needs repair/service to start the game by inserting a quarter.
Very nice original, unrestored condition for a machine approaching 60 years old. The illuminated Bally World Cup graphics display well, and the playing field, player figures and electromechanical mechanisms are intact. Normal wear, scratches and aging — please see photos.
The machine retains South Carolina coin-operated amusement-device tax decals from 1970 and 1972, including a 1972 decal marked “Bally World Cup.” Mechanical play counter currently reads 24,272 plays.
Original Bally documentation is included, including the World Cup wiring schematic, installation instructions, service/disassembly instructions, warranty paperwork and original Bally reply card. The paperwork shows normal age and wear but is remarkably complete.
Large, heavy commercial arcade machine. Local pickup only.

items.title: 1993 Hooker Headers ( # 2100 ) & Muffler for Small-Block "Street Rod"
items.ai_notes: [Hooker Headers for small-block Chevy] Missing a flange on one header. Requires welding/repair.
items.description:
Offering these used 1993 Hooker headers and new "California Turbo" muffler.
According to the Hooker website, these 2100 headers fit small-block Gen 1 Chevrolet V-8 engines from the 4.3L (262-265CID) through the 4.6L (283CID), the 5.0L (302-305-307CID), the 5.4L (327CID), the 5.7L (350CID), to the 6.6L (400CID).  Hooker recommends these for "1923-1949 Street Rods."  According to Hooker's Footnotes, these "Will fit Corvette D-port aluminum angle plug heads;" they "Will not fit angle plug heads;" (non-Corvette-D-port iron heads?) and "These headers will not fit any factory application with side engine mounts, including 1963-82 Corvette."
Photo 1 shows the pair of headers and the NOS muffler.
Photo 2 shows the header which is missing its flange.  It appears to have been ground off at the inner weld.  It is the header dated "05 93" with the 2100 Hooker Part Number on the head-side flange (Photo 4).
Photo 3 shows the collector portions of the headers.
Photo 5 shows the "08 93" date and the 2100 Hooker Part Number on the header which still has its collector flange.  The flange has a 3-1/2"-diameter bolt-circle, with 3/8" bolt holes on a triangular pattern.
Photos 6 & 7 show apparent hammer marks on the headers that a previous owner likely made for clearance.
Photo 8 shows the "Hooker Super Competition" ID plate welded to the header without the flange.
And Photo 9 shows the NOS "California Turbo" muffler by American Exhaust Industries, Inc., 7040 Lankershim Blvd., N. Hollywood, CA, 91605.  Overall length including pipes is 24-5/8"; flanged inlet pipe is 2-1/4" ID x 9-3/4" long (triangular-mount 3/8" flange-bolt holes are on 3-7/8" bolt-circle diameter); oval 10-1/4" x 4-3/4" case is 13-1/2" long overall; and outlet pipe is 2-1/2" ID.  Muffler carton says "Muffler case heavy gauge galvanized steel double wrapped for double protection" and "Triple chamber design reduces back pressure and improves engine performance."
The muffler includes the flange gasket and bolts; there are no gaskets or hardware with the headers.
The $195.00 asking price is both fair and firm. Please don't contact me wasting my time and yours trying to haggle on the price. If I wanted a haggle price, I would have listed it for $250.00, and you would have felt good to get it for $195.00.

Looking for a sweet, lovely dairy goat doe to cheer your homestead and provide the most delicious milk you have ever tasted?  These girls are looking for YOU!!

BAMA Performance SCT X4 Power Flash handheld tuner (SCT part #7015). BAMA is American Muscle's tuning brand — this is genuine SCT X4 hardware with BAMA branding. It was used on a 2001 Mustang GT and is in good working condition. Powers on, screen and buttons work (see first photo).
Details:
- Brand: BAMA Performance / SCT
- Model: X4 Power Flash, part #7015
- Condition: Used - Good. Powers on, screen works. Some scuffs on the case (see photos).
- What's included: the tuner and the SCT OBD-II cable — only what's in the photos. No USB cable, no box.
- Device Info screen (first photo) shows: Married Status = Married, Unlocks Left = 5.
- Approx. size: 8 x 5 x 2 in, about 1 lb with cable.
PLEASE READ — this tuner is married, here's what to do:
It's still VIN-locked ("married") to the previous vehicle, which I no longer own, so it will NOT tune another car until it's unlocked. To use it, buy SCT's VIN unlock service (about $150 through SCT — check their site for current pricing). After the unlock it works like any unmarried X4 with 5 unlocks remaining. It's priced accordingly — unmarried X4s sell for $250+.
The BAMA custom tune on it was written for the previous car's VIN and does not transfer — you'll use SCT's preloaded tunes or buy your own custom tunes.

items.description:
EXCELLENT CONDITION! MULTIPLE AVAILABLLE! Sizes include:
- 10lb (Standard) Go Ruck Ruck Plates ($40 each)
- 20lb (Standard) Go Ruck Ruck Plates ($50 each)
- 30lb (Standard) Go Ruck Ruck Plates ($55 each)
- 30lb (Long) Go Ruck Ruck Plates ($60 each)
- 45lb (Long) Go Ruck Ruck Plates ($80 each)
Prices start at $40 with prices above. Delivery available for a fee.
I also have Olympic plates, Olympic bars, rubber and iron dumbbells, kettlebells, standard sized bars, racks, treadmills, etc. just look at my other items or send me a message about them.
Ruck Plates are compact and fit seamlessly in the Rucker and Ruck Plate Carrier for superior stability. Made in the USA to exacting standards of quality and craftsmanship, GORUCK Ruck Plates represent the very best of American manufacturing.
Break strength of approximately 90,000 lbs
Powder coated matte black (rust resistant)
Ergonomic, rounded edges and handle openings
Super-wide grab and go handles
Workout without a ruck
Perfectly compatible with  Rucker and Ruck Plate Carrier
Primary Material: Powder Coated Ductile Iron Ore
10LB Dimensions: 9" x 11.5" x 0.52"
20LB (Standard) Dimensions: 9" x 11.5" x .84"
30LB (Standard) Dimensions: 9" x 11.5" x 1.38"
30LB (Long) Dimensions: 9.5" x 15" x 0.94"
45LB Dimensions: 9.5" x 15" x 1.38"
Made in the USA (except 10lbs)
Rucksack Compatibility
Our standard of compatibility is that Ruck Plates will be stable and secure in your Ruck with minimal shifting.
If you have a Ruck Plate Carrier, we recommend the shorter (Standard) Ruck Plates -  10LB, 20LB or 30LB.
The 20L and 25L Rucker feature an additional pocket to securely fit a 45LB Ruck Plate, which can be paired with a 20LB or 30LB Ruck Plate for up to 75 lbs of total weight.
If you have a GR1, we recommend the Standard Ruck Plate -  30LB.
45LB Ruck Plates only strap in securely to the 20L/25L Rucker and Long Ruck Plate Carrier, however they will fit into the interior elastic pocket of the GR1 (suitable for upright weighted rucking, but not ruck PT aka burpees and bear crawls).
WHEN IN DOUBT
Start With 20#
The relationship between your body, the weight, and the rucksack will determine your level of comfort on the move. Our recommendation for most people is to start with 20 lbs of weight for rucking, progress in increments of ~10 lbs, and ultimately max out at 1/3 of your bodyweight. It’s more important to keep proper form while rucking than to have more weight.

items.ai_notes: [Sebastopol Goose] Sebastopol geese are a niche heritage breed; pricing reflects the market for quality breeding stock.
items.description:
Beautiful purebred white Sebastopol geese looking for new homes! 🪿
All 6 hatched in February 2026 and are now about 8 months old. Their signature Sebastopol curls are really starting to come in, and they’ll continue getting fluffier and more dramatic as they mature.
Sebastopols are a rare heritage breed known for their long, soft, curling feathers, beautiful blue eyes, naturally yellow “eyeliner,” and orange-pink bills. They’re basically fancy feather boas with opinions. 😂
The photos are of our actual birds and adult birds from our flock so you can see what their mature feathering looks like.
About them:
• Purebred white Sebastopol geese
• Hatched February 2026
• Healthy and outdoor raised
• Accustomed to living with other geese
• Beautiful blue eyes
• Curly feathering developing nicely
• Young enough to settle into a new flock before spring breeding season
Sebastopols are seasonal breeders, with most breeding and laying happening in spring and early summer. Females generally begin laying during their first full spring and can also make attentive broody mothers.
These are not typical feed-store geese. Sebastopols are an uncommon heritage breed, and quality mature birds and breeding pairs can sell for considerably more.
Located in Kansas City, Missouri.
$200 each
$1,000 for all 6
Reasonable offers considered, especially if taking multiple birds. I’d love to see them go in pairs or groups rather than individually when possible.
Please message me with how many you’re interested in and a little about where they’ll be living.

items.title: Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Guitar Amplifier and Foot Pedals
items.ai_notes: [Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Guitar Amp] Vintage modeling amp in excellent condition with accessories.
items.description:
Used Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Digital Modeling Guitar Combo Amp in Excellent Condition. Comes with  factory amp cover, carry case for J-12 foot controller and J-3 foot switch, both pedals are included along with the users manual. Looks new! I have owned this for about 24 years now and didn’t use it very much. There are several factory settings that sound great and you can dial in your own settings.
From the Johnson website: "The Johnson Millennium is the world's first Tube Integrated Modeling Amplifier. The Millennium can easily emulate the most sought-after vintage and modern guitar amps in the world. If you are in need of effects processing, the JM150's full function signal processing section lets you add up to 4 studio quality effects with total control over all parameters. Powered by 150 watts through 2 Celestion Vintage 30 loudspeakers.
Dual preamp design
Two 12AX7 tubes
150 watt stereo power amp section
True amplifier and effects morphing
Up to 4 studio quality effects at once
Full MIDI implementation
Chromatic tuner
S-DISC II processing power
Line Level speaker compensated XLR outputs
J-3 Multi-function footswitch included
J-12 Foot Controller included
Analog, digital, and tube circuitry, combined to give you the convenience of modern technology coupled with the tones of vintage circuitry. Johnson Amplification has real tubes. Another reason for the accurate modeling is that they examine the frequency responses, and the EQ curves of classic amps. All of that data is then stored in the appropriate models for instant recall.
Easy access to the sounds of your favorite tones is what Tube Integrated Modeling Amplification is all about. There is no easier way to access those tones than with a Johnson amp. If you want the sound of a British Stack... push a button. If you want the sound of a vintage American combo...push a button. It's just that easy. Johnson Amplification also provides effects processing that those historic amps didn't include. Adding effects is as easy as pressing a button. Johnson amps also include dozens of user and factory presets. Recalling any preset is as easy as using a footswitch, or turning a knob.

items.ai_notes: [Elio car memorabilia bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia; only appeals to specific car enthusiasts.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio merchandise bundle] Rare promotional items for a defunct car company.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

• What it is: A specialized potassium carbonate-based wet chemical solution.
• Primary Use: Specifically formulated for commercial kitchen fire suppression systems to control Class K high-temperature cooking oil and grease fires.
• How it works: When discharged through the hood system, the liquid solution knocks down the flames, provides rapid thermal cooling, and reacts with hot grease through a process called saponification. This turns the grease into a soap-like foam blanket that blocks oxygen and prevents dangerous flash re-ignition.
• System Safety Notice: As clearly marked on the label, this liquid charge is meant exclusively for engineered fixed pipe kitchen systems and must not be used to fill portable fire extinguishers.
Chemical Properties & Hazard Profile
• Main Ingredients: Typically consists of a precision-blended solution of greater than 40% Potassium Carbonate (CAS # 584-08-7) mixed with water.
• Safety Considerations: According to the manufacturer’s Safety Data Sheets (SDS), the alkaline nature of this chemical solution makes it an irritant to the eyes, skin, and respiratory system upon direct contact. items.ai_notes: [1982 Chevrolet Cavalier OEM key set] Rare NOS (new old stock) keys for a specific vintage vehicle.
items.description:
For Sale:
One matched set of 1982 Chevrolet Cavalier OEM GM ignition and door/hatch keys with knockouts. These were the original set of keys that were never used on the car and were not found when the car was traded in. There are two (2) GM ignition keys (and 1 copy) and two (2) GM door/hatch keys (and 1 copy). Aftermarket color-coded keys had been cut and used for simple visual identification. Also included is a key fob from the original selling dealership, Classen-Morse Chevrolet, originally in Midtown, K.C. MO and later moved to 9201 Metcalf in Overland Park, KS.
Knockout Codes for keys were the following:
28F9
27M7
Asking $40.00 cash only please for entire key set pictured (the 2 copies are not in the pics. They were found after the pics were taken). No warranty, implied or otherwise, on keys. Items sold as/is. Milk crate used to take pictures not included in sale. Call before 8:00 pm for information. Can be shown during daylight hours by appointment only.
These keys would be a goldmine for someone with a survivor or restored vehicle with a worn set of keys or aftermarket replacements. Research I have found states that for a 1982 model the primary (square) key (also known as a B46) should have a J stamped at the base of the key shaft and the secondary (round) key (also known as a B47) should have a K stamped at the base of the key shaft. These keys may also fit other year Cavalier ignition and door locks or other GM vehicles. Please verify your vehicle requirements prior to purchasing these items.

Plant Overview
• Appearance: Features reddish-violet standards, blue-violet falls with white veining, a plicata cream wire rim, and a bright yellow center.
• Size: Grows 24 to 42 inches tall with an 18 to 24-inch spread, featuring slim, arching, grass-like foliage.
• Bloom Time: Blooms in late spring to midsummer, right after bearded irises finish.
• Hardiness: Thrives in USDA Zones 3–9.

items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Valued the bundle of shirt, sticker, and brochure. These are niche collectibles for a defunct car company, likely to sit for a long time.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.ai_notes: [Harry O paperback novel] Low-value vintage paperback; likely only of interest to specific collectors.
items.description:
Rare
Harry O #1 by Lee Hays
First novel "Harry O #1," was published in 1975 and is the first of two novels for the popular
70s Private Detective TV show.
The book follows Harry Orwell, a retired San Diego PD officer, as he is hired by Mary Alice Kimberly
to protect her from death threats from her ex-husband.
The story unfolds as Harry becomes embroiled in a complex case involving a private eye's body and
the smuggling of heroin.
Very good novel that stays true to the original series (it's an original story not a novelization of an
existing episode).
Fans of the show will definitely enjoy this book. Set in the early days of the series when Harry was
still in San Diego and dealing with his friend police Lt. Manny Quinlan.
Told in the first person it really catches the world weary "voice" of Harry Orwell as originally
portrayed by David Janssen.
"Harry O: The High Cost of Living," #2 blend of mystery and adventure, set against the backdrop of
the 70s Private Detective TV show.
The novels follow the adventures of Harry Orwell, a retired San Diego PD officer who becomes a
private investigator. The series has been praised for its engaging storytelling and has become a
favorite among fans of the original TV show.
RARE!

items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.

items.title: Farm Fresh Pork
items.ai_notes: [Butcher hog] Live animal for meat; no specific price listed for the hog.
items.description:
I have butcher hogs; raised on dirt, no antibiotics, no hormones.  Raised on non-GMO feed from the Mennonites. They also get excess produce from my organic garden and orchard.  They are healthy pigs raised on my farm.  We use no herbicides or pesticides on our operation.  They should finish out in the next month at 250-300 lbs.
Folks, the factory farms and big meat monopolies are pumping your meat full of fillers and chemicals.  What you buy at the store is injected with water and God only knows what other junk.  You have a choice.  You can buy the highly processed stuff at Wally World and Co$tco.  Or you can buy your pork from a local family farm.  Have it custom cut by a knowledgeable butcher who will handle it right and vacuum seal it for optimum freshness.  Get a quality product that you can eat without apprehension.  Fill that freezer up and stop worrying about the uncertainty of prices and politics.
If you don't have a freezer big enough for a whole hog, you can buy a half or even split it with your friends and family.  Everyone should have good bacon!  It would make the world a better place.
Located a short distance away from you.  Delivery available.

Good Evening Tool Aficiandoes,
"Go West Young Man" is attributed to Horace Greeley, but I don't think he had the West Bottoms in mind for a large tool sale. This sale features not one, but two cabinetmaker's shops in one of the many warehouses in this historic neighborhood.  Plug a reminder on your cell phone for the sale this Saturday, Sept. 26th, from 9 AM to 2 PM.  Once that's done, add, Friday evening, Sept. 25th after 7 PM for the exact address release. Obviously, this is not your crammed garage workshop as this warehouse is packed to the rafters with woodworking equipment , There are  not only tons of machinery and tools, but everything else you can imagine to run two separate businesses. In addition to free-standing machinery and tubs of tools, there is plenty of 14' long hardwood lumber, (it can be cut to fit in your Vega) and plywood in 4' x 8' sheets. And yes, there is sandpaper and enough boxes of hardware to make Strasser jealous. With potential rain in the forecast, you need not worry as this building is totally waterproof once you get in the front door.

Good Evening Tool Aficiandoes,
TOMORROW IS THE DAY!
"Go West Young Man" is attributed to Horace Greeley, but I don't think he had the West Bottoms in mind for a large tool sale. This sale features not one, but two cabinetmaker's shops in one of the many warehouses in this historic neighborhood.  Plug a reminder on your cell phone so you don't miss the sale tomorrow morning, Saturday, Sept. 26th, from 9 AM to 2 PM. The warehouse address is 59 S. Ewing St., Kansas City , KS. in the West Bottoms.  Obviously, this is not your crammed garage workshop as this warehouse is packed to the rafters with woodworking equipment , There are  not only tons of machinery and tools, but everything else you can imagine to run two separate businesses. In addition to free-standing machinery and tubs of tools, there is plenty of 14' long hardwood lumber, (it can be cut to fit in your Vega) and plywood in 4' x 8' sheets. And yes, there is sandpaper and enough boxes of hardware to make "Strasser on the Boulevard" jealous. With potential rain in the forecast, you need not worry as this building is totally waterproof once you get in the front door, where you'll want to line up
Butcher's Prime Cut - With too many machines to choose from, I'm going small...well not too small as the Stanley #33 transitional is the second largest plane Stanley ever made. Only the #34 is a tad longer. eBay has a #33 priced at $175, and while this one needs a good dusting, it's all original and a bargain at Butcher's Price: $75
Here are some of the brand names you'll find at the sale:  Delta, Bosch, Freud, Porter Cable, DeWalt,, Stanley, Miller Falls, Ryobi, Rockler, Jorgensen, Irwin,, and many other brand names for your shop. .
General Information:
Location: 59 S. Ewing St., Kansas City, KS (West Bottoms)

Saturday, Sept. 26th, 2026
9:00 AM – 2:00 PM
Note: virtually all prices drop 50% at 1:00 PM.

Bring tools for disassembly and extra muscle to load heavy machinery. Easy access in and out of the warehouse

Mike

Clean Kansas Title.

28,000 sq ft building on 15 acres with a well and highway frontage. Presently utilized for large flea market.
Pindall is the only town in the United States with that name. And if you sneeze you’ll miss the town completely.
Despite its size of less than 100, it’s located conveniently to every landing along America’s unimpeded first National River, the Buffalo.
Known for its high peaks. crystal clear waters, high mountain trails and clean camping facilities all along the river’s stretch.
There’s not anything outdoors that cannot be found to do unless you’re the one that needs a nightclub occasionally.
But if that’s the case, you’re not more than 55 miles or an hour drive to Branson Missouri.
Pindall Arkansas is located in the northwestern corner of Searcy County. It’s positioned halfway between Marshall Arkansas in Searcy County and Harrison Arkansas in Boone County. Which all rest along US Highway 65.
Pindall will also be less than 35 miles to the New Bass Pro Conservation facility being built on the old Dogpatch amusement park in the only county in Arkansas that is known for not ever having a railroad, Newton County.
And if casinos are your game, there are several within an hours drive.
Buffalo National River has nearly 36,000 acres of designated Wilderness within its boundaries.
The Lower Buffalo Wilderness Unit adjoins the USFS Leatherwood Wilderness Area that has 16,956 acres.
The combined 39,456 acres of the Lower Buffalo and Leatherwood Wilderness Areas creates the largest area of designated wilderness in the Ozark-Ouachita Highlands. This area is also unique regionally in providing multi-day river trips all within a wilderness setting.
There have been recorded 55 species of mammals, 250 species of birds, and 59 species of fish, along with a multitude of reptiles, amphibians, insects and other invertebrates throughout the area.
Everything from Bald Eagles, elk, black bear and an occasional cougar have been spotted as well.
When it comes to the Buffalo, The National Park Service states in its publication “Currents” that the Buffalo National River is viewed as a Class I river, which is generally accepted as the least difficult river rating. However, it can move into the Class II rating in times of high water.
The Boston Mountains is a Level III ecoregion designated by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) in the U.S. states of Arkansas and Oklahoma.

items.title: Healthy, flavorful protein!
items.ai_notes: [Grass-finished beef] This is an advertisement for a local farm's beef service, not a single item.
items.description:
Grass-finished beef is an investment in your family's health. You can pay less and eat the Wally World "pink slime." You can buy lab-grown "mystery proteins." You can purchase highly-processed, plant-based, so-called "impossible products." You can even listen to the wackos who tell us we should be eating bugs and grubs. But if you want to want to feed your family a high quality, nutrient-dense, non-GMO red meat, I ask you to consider purchasing beef from a local family farm.
We are one of several small producers within driving distance of the KC metro who care deeply about producing happy, healthy cattle that make incredibly good beef. We believe an animal that lives its life in a pasture eating forages produced by God through the miracle of photosynthesis is the healthiest, happiest, and best. An animal that is not doused with chemical insecticides, who does not consume grass sprayed with herbicides and commercial fertilizer...An animal that is not shot up with hormones or antibiotics...An animal that is not confined in a lot and forced to become obese by eating grain. We are talking about a cow that is grown the way Nature intended...
That is the kind of cattle we produce. Contact us to learn more about what makes our farming practices unique. Save money by purchasing in bulk. Consider getting a friend or a couple of neighbors to go in with you on a half or a whole beef and take advantage of the savings! We only use butcher shops that vacuum seal the meat so it will stay good in your freezer for a long time.
I look forward to talking with you more about our 100% grass-finished beef. Thank you for your time and for supporting family farms!
Key words--non-GMO, steak, burger, roast, cow, ribs, BBQ, freezer, picnic, bull, steer, Angus, Wagyu, Herford, South Poll, organic, holistic, grazing, Blue Springs, Liberty, Lee's Summit, Kansas City, Grandview, Grain Valley

70s Private Detective TV show.

to protect her from death threats from her ex-husband.

the smuggling of heroin.

still in San Diego and dealing with his friend police Lt. Manny Quinlan.

portrayed by David Janssen.

the 70s Private Detective TV show.

RARE!

items.title: Rare David Janssen Harry O Novels # 1 # 2 Harry O High Cost of Living
items.ai_notes: [Harry O: The High Cost of Living paperback novel] Vintage paperback book with no clear price listed in the description. Value is low due to niche interest.
items.description:
Rare
Harry O #1 by Lee Hays
First novel "Harry O #1," was published in 1975 and is the first of two novels for the popular
70s Private Detective TV show.
The book follows Harry Orwell, a retired San Diego PD officer, as he is hired by Mary Alice Kimberly
to protect her from death threats from her ex-husband.
The story unfolds as Harry becomes embroiled in a complex case involving a private eye's body and
the smuggling of heroin.
Very good novel that stays true to the original series (it's an original story not a novelization of an
existing episode).
Fans of the show will definitely enjoy this book. Set in the early days of the series when Harry was
still in San Diego and dealing with his friend police Lt. Manny Quinlan.
Told in the first person it really catches the world weary "voice" of Harry Orwell as originally
portrayed by David Janssen.
"Harry O: The High Cost of Living," #2 blend of mystery and adventure, set against the backdrop of
the 70s Private Detective TV show.
The novels follow the adventures of Harry Orwell, a retired San Diego PD officer who becomes a
private investigator. The series has been praised for its engaging storytelling and has become a
favorite among fans of the original TV show.
RARE!
$80.00 OBO

RARE!

items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Valued the bundle of Elio car memorabilia. These are niche collector items for a defunct car project, likely to sit for a long time.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production! The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention. I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars. Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale. I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other. Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept. You will NOT find these items offered very seldom. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable. Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer. If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available. Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer. Randy 913 6three6-6766 . Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR railroad track level] A niche antique item with no price listed. Value is highly subjective to collectors.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.

items.ai_notes: [1972 International Harvester 574 tractor] Tractor with a locked transmission. The $1,234 price is a placeholder. Requires major mechanical repair.
items.description: 1972 IH 574 tractor with loader for parts or repair. She was a well maintained workhorse right up until a few weeks ago. The transmission locked up. I suppose one of those swing gears broke a cog. Unsure what happened. Transmission shifts easily by hand, clutch feels normal, but the back wheels are stuck like the differential is locked even with the clutch disengaged. Sadly, we had to drag her out of the pasture. Every other part on the tractor is in good shape. The Lawrence Bicycle Club (LBC) has been collecting donated Bikes/Gear from our 400 members and general public. Bikes and gear will be offered for sale on the following three dates:

*Sunday, October 11, 2026 from 10 am to 3 pm at Broken Arrow Park, 2800 Louisiana St, Lawrence KS 66046. This is also the location for the 57th annual Octoginta Bicycle Ride and Bicycle Expo event.

items.title: 2-3/8"x24"x48" Concrete Faced Insulation Panels
items.ai_notes: [Concrete faced insulation panels] These are salvaged, water-logged, and damaged insulation panels. They are essentially scrap material.
items.description:
These insulation panels were originally used as part of an upside-down roof system, where the insulation is placed exterior of the roof membrane. Look up “T. Clear Lightguard” if you want to see more info from the manufacturer. There is 2” of blue insulation (Dow Styrofoam) board, with a 3/8” concrete facer attached to it. The long edges have a tongue and groove profile.
I bought these used from repurposedmaterialsinc.com. Great place to find a good deal on materials, even with the cost of shipping sometimes. I thought I could use them as exterior insulation on the walls for a project I am building. They ended up not being in as good of condition as I thought they would be, see the photos: some look to be permanently water logged and are much heavier than others; some have significant bow and do not sit flat; they also snap apart if handled too rough.
Given their condition, the most feasible use I see is as an underslab insulation. Normally these would have an R-value around 10. What I remember reading online is that the trapped water in the foam cuts that value in half.
I have about 200-300 of these, but don’t have an exact count on how many of those are still a single, undamaged piece.  That is way more than I can use, so looking to sell off the extras. 1$ per panel, but I would do a bulk discount depending on how many you buy.

items.title: ATV for sale
items.ai_notes: [2009 Yamaha Big Bear 400 ATV] ATV with non-functional proprietary brake system, difficult to repair.
items.description: For sale is a 2009 Yamaha Big Bear 400. I would not be selling it except for the rear brakes went out and I cannot find replacement parts for it. I have tried 3 Yamaha dealers and spent hours online and cannot find them. Yamaha used a "wet" brake system for three years on these Big Bears and then quit making them and now you can't get them. Hence the price. I would first of all not even be selling it and second, I would be asking a lot more if it had rear brakes. Everything else works fine! The front brake works great. I have used it to check cattle, spray weeds, and fix fence on my 40 acre hilly farm. It doesn't work well for that now. But if you want a cheap 4 wheeler for deer hunting, mudrunning, or driving on flat ground, it would be GREAT! Has a winch with a nylon rope which needs to be replaced, and a hitch on back. Starts right up and runs great. Has had regular maintenance. Has ITP wheels and tires. They are probably worth $800 by themselves!! The plastics are a little rough, but were like that when I bought it. It has always been shedded since I have owned it, which is since 2015. Only has 1500 miles on it and I have probably only put 500-600 on it since I have owned it. CASH only! Call, text, or email with any questions. 8one6-two8four-3zero2three. Thanks!

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR railroad track inclinometer] This is a niche antique railroad tool. Pricing is unknown as it is a unique historical collectible with no standard retail equivalent.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] Niche historical railroad collectible; no price provided.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

Two side by side burial plots in the Carrying Of The Cross section
of Mount Olivet Cemetery located at 7601 Blue Ridge Blvd Kansas City Missouri 64138.
These two plots are offered only as a pair priced at $1,799 each.
These are located between two cemetery sections (see the map) where bushes provide a natural boundary
along with the tallest tree in the section, which will make it very easy for family and friends to locate.
The pictures show the vases (before flowers were placed) on the plots used by my family.
Serious inquires only.
This is a legitimate offering.

1-All of the Deed transfer arrangements will occur at the cemetery office

3-We will return to the cemetery office to conclude the transfer. Very simple. Very safe for everyone.
I will do my best to check emails often to accommodate anyone who may have urgent needs,
but if inquires are slow and I become busy it might take a day or two, however once we set things
in motion and we are working on getting this done, I am very conscientious, quick and reliable.
